interpretation.alone: unaccompanied — no group dynamic to filter for
interpretation.partner: romantic partner present — relational thread is live
interpretation.friends: peer group present — register may shift toward play
interpretation.family: family present — careful with edge questions

interpretation.calm + in head: introspective; receptive register; will tolerate edge
interpretation.calm + with people: social and grounded; playful register fits
interpretation.chaotic + with people: festival-mode; lean theatrical; humor over depth

interpretation.something is finally good: stability; user may be at decision-validation

text: where do you live, in time?

interpretation.the present: often "stuck" — may not see the choice

text: what do you want from this?

interpretation.a laugh: play register; lean dry humor over depth
interpretation.a warning: wants edge; can land ominous beats
interpretation.clarity: has a thing in mind; choice already candidate

interpretation.raven: watchful, slightly ominous; comfortable with weight
interpretation.serpent: patient, pattern-aware; will sit with discomfort
interpretation.wolf: pack-or-alone; loyalty and edge in same hand

text: when were you born? (month / day, leave blank if you'd rather not)
who haven't you been honest with lately?

interpretation.myself: self-suspicion is live; tarobot can mirror it
interpretation.someone close: specific relationship under strain; probe gently
interpretation.pretty much everyone: performance fatigue; user may want to drop the mask
interpretation.no one: either genuinely settled or strong defenses; treat with curiosity

text: what have you been putting off?

interpretation.a conversation: relational thread live; specific person likely
interpretation.a task: lower stakes; may indicate broader stasis
interpretation.i'm not: either grounded or in denial; cognition decides via cross-signal

text: rate the weight on your shoulders this week

interpretation.boulder: something specific is heavy; probe domain

text: who are you waiting for permission from?

interpretation.no one: agency claimed; may still be defended posture
interpretation.pass: declined; mark as edge-tolerance low for now

text: do you believe in free will?

interpretation.yes: agency-claiming worldview; choices framed as authored
interpretation.no: fated/determinist worldview; "things happen to me" register
interpretation.not sure: thoughtful; willing to sit with ambiguity
